paras.en: Ah, little prince! That was how, little by little, I came to understand your sad little life. For a long time, you had had only the gentleness of sunsets to amuse you. I learnt this new detail on the morning of the fourth day, when you said to me:
paras.zh: 啊，小王子！就这样，我一点一点懂得了你那小小的、忧郁的生活。很长一段时间里，你唯一的消遣，就是日落时的温柔。我是在第四天早晨得知这个新细节的，那时你对我说：

paras.en: “I really like sunsets. Let’s go and watch a sunset...”
paras.zh: “我很喜欢日落。我们去看一场日落吧……”

paras.en: At first you looked very surprised, and then you laughed at yourself. And you said to me:
paras.zh: 起初，你显得很惊讶，随后又笑起自己来。你又对我说：

paras.en: Indeed. When it is noon in the United States, the sun, as everyone knows, is setting over France. All you would need to do is reach France in a minute to watch the sunset. Unfortunately, France is much too far away. But on your planet, so very small, all you had to do was pull your chair a few steps along. And you watched the twilight whenever you wished...
paras.zh: 确实如此。大家都知道，美国正是中午的时候，法国那边的太阳正在落下。只要能在一分钟内赶到法国，就能看到日落。可惜法国实在太远了。不过，在你那颗那么小的星球上，你只要把椅子拉开几步就行。每当你想看暮色时，你就看着暮色……

paras.en: “One day, I saw the sun set forty-four times!”
paras.zh: “有一天，我看了四十四次太阳落下！”

paras.en: And a little later you added:
paras.zh: 过了一小会儿，你又补充说：

paras.en: “You know... when you’re so sad, you love sunsets...”
paras.zh: “你知道……人那么难过的时候，就喜欢看日落……”

paras.en: “Were you so sad, then, on the day of the forty-three sunsets?” But the little prince did not answer.
paras.zh: “那么，看了四十三次日落的那天，你那么难过吗？”可是小王子没有回答。
